lines.text: Many learners say: Please explain me this word.
Better: Please explain this word to me.
To me! Please explain it to me.

data.right: Please explain this word to me.

native.tip: explain 뒤에 사람이 바로 오지 않아요. “explain this word to me”예요.
native.caption: “Please explain me this word”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 explain은 사람을 바로 뒤에 쓸 수 없고 ‘to + 사람’으로 말해요. “Please explain this word to me”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “to me”. explain it to me 통째로! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Do not put a person right after explain. Say “explain it to me”.
en.caption: Do you say “Please explain me this word”? 😅 With explain, the person comes after “to”. “Please explain this word to me” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
